The '''blobstacle course''' was a course for [[blob racing]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]] which was involved in [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]].<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blobstacle course first appeared in [[Kevin J. Anderson]]'s book [[Jedi Search]] where [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] visits Umgul in search of a potential jedi for Luke's newly founded academy, later in the first entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a two part article written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] and released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]].
